shots.prompt: Cinematic deep-sea documentary shot. A vintage 1960 bathyscaphe (long grey cigar-shaped float with a small steel crew sphere underneath) sinks slowly and steadily downward through dark blue ocean water, staying the same shape and size. Its single lamp casts a soft beam that gently sways; tiny white marine-snow particles drift upward past the lens; small air bubbles rise from the float. The camera slowly tilts down to follow it. Calm, smooth, slow motion, realistic underwater light rays fading into darkness. No people, no text.

Cinematic deep-sea documentary shot of a volcanic vent on a dark rocky seafloor. Streams of shiny silvery droplets rise continuously from cracks in the rock like champagne bubbles, wobbling as they rise; white mineral clouds billow and drift slowly; pale mussels stay still on the rocks; fine particles float in the water. The camera pushes in very slowly. Smooth, realistic, slow motion, steady camera. No people, no text.
